name: ClassFormation.intersectionIndexCardinal_image_eq_saturation
statement:
theorem intersectionIndexCardinal_image_eq_saturation (d : G →* D)
    (L K : Subgroup G) :
    Cardinal.lift.{u} (intersectionIndexCardinal (L.map d) (K.map d)) =
      Cardinal.lift.{v}
        (intersectionIndexCardinal (K ⊓ (L ⊔ d.ker)) K)

name: ClassFormation.map_relIndex_eq_saturation_relIndex
statement:
theorem map_relIndex_eq_saturation_relIndex (d : G →* D)
    (L K : Subgroup G) :
    (L.map d).relIndex (K.map d) =
      (K ⊓ (L ⊔ d.ker)).relIndex K

name: ClassFormation.relIndex_eq_map_relIndex_mul_inf_ker_relIndex
statement:
theorem relIndex_eq_map_relIndex_mul_inf_ker_relIndex (d : G →* D) {L K : Subgroup G}
    (hLK : L ≤ K) :
    L.relIndex K =
      (L.map d).relIndex (K.map d) * (L ⊓ d.ker).relIndex (K ⊓ d.ker)

name: ClassFormation.relIndex_saturation_eq_inf_ker_relIndex
statement:
theorem relIndex_saturation_eq_inf_ker_relIndex (d : G →* D)
    {L K : Subgroup G} (hLK : L ≤ K) :
    L.relIndex (K ⊓ (L ⊔ d.ker)) =
      (L ⊓ d.ker).relIndex (K ⊓ d.ker)

name: ClassFormation.relativeIndexCardinal_eq_index_of_finite
statement:
theorem relativeIndexCardinal_eq_index_of_finite {L K : Subgroup G} (hLK : L ≤ K)
    [Finite (K ⧸ L.subgroupOf K)] :
    relativeIndexCardinal hLK = (L.relIndex K : Cardinal)

name: ClassFormation.relativeIndexCardinal_eq_map_mul_inf_ker
statement:
theorem relativeIndexCardinal_eq_map_mul_inf_ker (d : G →* D)
    {L K : Subgroup G} (hLK : L ≤ K) :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (relativeIndexCardinal hLK) =
      Cardinal.lift.{u}
          (relativeIndexCardinal (Subgroup.map_mono (f := d) hLK)) *
        Cardinal.lift.{v}
          (relativeIndexCardinal
            (show L ⊓ d.ker ≤ K ⊓ d.ker from inf_le_inf hLK le_rfl))

name: ClassFormation.relativeIndexCardinal_kernel_eq_saturation
statement:
theorem relativeIndexCardinal_kernel_eq_saturation (d : G →* D)
    {L K : Subgroup G} (hLK : L ≤ K) :
    relativeIndexCardinal
      (show L ⊓ d.ker ≤ K ⊓ d.ker from inf_le_inf hLK le_rfl) =
      relativeIndexCardinal
        (show L ≤ K ⊓ (L ⊔ d.ker) from fun _ hx ↦
          ⟨hLK hx, (show L ≤ L ⊔ d.ker from le_sup_left) hx⟩)

name: ClassFormation.relativeIndexCardinal_mul
statement:
theorem relativeIndexCardinal_mul {M L K : Subgroup G}
    (hML : M ≤ L) (hLK : L ≤ K) :
    relativeIndexCardinal hML * relativeIndexCardinal hLK =
      relativeIndexCardinal (hML.trans hLK)

    (K L : ClosedSubgroup G) (hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.toSubgroup)
    [hnormal : (extensionSubgroup K L hLK).Normal]
    [hfinite : Finite (K.toSubgroup ⧸ extensionSubgroup K L hLK)]
    (g : K.toSubgroup ⧸ extensionSubgroup K L hLK)
    (hg : ∀ q, q ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g)
    (wp : extensionFixedRepresentation A K L hLK hnormal ⟶
      extensionFixedRepresentation A K L hLK hnormal)
    (n : ℕ+) (xi : (extensionFixedRepresentation A K L hLK hnormal).V)
    (hxi_order : addOrderOf xi = (n : ℕ))
    (hxi_kernel : wp.hom xi = 0)
    (hxi_fixed : ∀ q : K.toSubgroup ⧸ extensionSubgroup K L hLK,
      (extensionFixedRepresentation A K L hLK hnormal).ρ q xi = xi)
    (hexponent : ∀ q : K.toSubgroup ⧸ extensionSubgroup K L hLK,
      q ^ (n : ℕ) = 1) :
    ∃ a : (extensionFixedRepresentation A K L hLK hnormal).V,
      (∀ q : K.toSubgroup ⧸ extensionSubgroup K L hLK,
        (extensionFixedRepresentation A K L hLK hnormal).ρ q (wp.hom a) = wp.hom a) ∧
      representationStabilizer (extensionFixedRepresentation A K L hLK hnormal) a = ⊥

    (hxi_order : addOrderOf xi = (n : ℕ))
    (hxi_kernel : wp.hom xi = 0)
    (hxi_fixed : ∀ k : K.toSubgroup, A.ρ k.1 xi = xi)
    (hker : AddMonoidHom.ker (AddMonoidHomClass.toAddMonoidHom wp.hom) ≤
      AddSubgroup.zmultiples xi)
    (hexponent :
      ∀ q : K.toSubgroup ⧸ extensionSubgroup (G := G) K L hLK,
        q ^ (n : ℕ) = 1) :
    closedSetFixingSubgroup A hcontinuous K
      (kummerRadicalAddSubgroup A wp K L : Set A.V) = L

name: KummerTheory.kummerRadical_fixed_of_ker_le_zmultiples
statement:
theorem kummerRadical_fixed_of_ker_le_zmultiples
    (A : Rep ℤ G) (wp : A ⟶ A) (K L : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.toSubgroup)
    (xi : A.V)
    (hxi_fixed : ∀ k : K.toSubgroup, A.ρ k.1 xi = xi)
    (hker : AddMonoidHom.ker (AddMonoidHomClass.toAddMonoidHom wp.hom) ≤
      AddSubgroup.zmultiples xi)
    {a : A.V} (ha : a ∈ kummerRadicalAddSubgroup A wp K L)
    (l : L.toSubgroup) :
    A.ρ l.1 a = a

name: KummerTheory.mem_ambientFixedAddSubgroup_iff
statement:

theorem mem_ambientFixedAddSubgroup_iff
    (A : Rep ℤ G) (H : ClosedSubgroup G) (a : A.V) :

name: KummerTheory.mem_kummerRadicalAddSubgroup_iff

      wp.hom a ∈ kummerDeltaAddSubgroup A wp K L

name: ClassFormation.leftMulCosetEquiv_mk

name: ClassFormation.relativeCosetAction_add
statement:
theorem relativeCosetAction_add
    (A : Rep ℤ G) (K L : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.toSubgroup)
    (a b : ambientFixedAddSubgroup A L)
    (q : K.toSubgroup ⧸ extensionSubgroup K L hLK) :
    relativeCosetAction A K L hLK (a + b) q =
      relativeCosetAction A K L hLK a q +
        relativeCosetAction A K L hLK b q

name: ClassFormation.relativeCosetAction_mk
statement:

theorem relativeCosetAction_mk

    relativeCosetAction A K L hLK a (QuotientGroup.mk k) = A.ρ k.1 a.1

name: ClassFormation.relativeCosetAction_zero

theorem relativeCosetAction_zero

name: ClassFormation.chosenOrbitClassEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chosenOrbitClassEquiv_symm_apply
    {M : Type*} {X : Type*} [Group M] [MulAction M X]
    {φ : Quotient (orbitRel M X) → X}
    (hφ : Function.LeftInverse Quotient.mk'' φ)
    (q : Quotient (orbitRel M X))
    (r : M ⧸ stabilizer M (φ q)) :
    (MulAction.selfEquivSigmaOrbitsQuotientStabilizer' M X hφ).symm
        ⟨q, r⟩ = r.out • φ q

name: ClassFormation.mem_relativeNormDoubleCoset_stabilizer_iff
statement:
theorem mem_relativeNormDoubleCoset_stabilizer_iff
    (K K' S : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hSK : S.toSubgroup ≤ K.toSubgroup)
    (hK'K : K'.toSubgroup ≤ K.toSubgroup)
    (t : K.toSubgroup)
    (k' : extensionSubgroup K K' hK'K) :
    k' ∈ MulAction.stabilizer (extensionSubgroup K K' hK'K)
        (QuotientGroup.mk t :
          K.toSubgroup ⧸ extensionSubgroup K S hSK) ↔
      t.1⁻¹ * k'.1.1 * t.1 ∈ S.toSubgroup

name: ClassFormation.relativeNormDoubleCosetEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relativeNormDoubleCosetEquiv_symm_apply
    (K K' S : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hSK : S.toSubgroup ≤ K.toSubgroup)
    (hK'K : K'.toSubgroup ≤ K.toSubgroup)
    (q : Quotient (orbitRel (extensionSubgroup K K' hK'K)
      (K.toSubgroup ⧸ extensionSubgroup K S hSK)))
    (r : (extensionSubgroup K K' hK'K) ⧸
      MulAction.stabilizer (extensionSubgroup K K' hK'K) q.out) :
    (relativeNormDoubleCosetEquiv K K' S hSK hK'K).symm ⟨q, r⟩ =
      r.out • q.out

name: ClassFormation.leftCosetEquivMapOfSurjective_mk

name: ClassFormation.leftCosetEquivMapOfSurjective_smul
statement:

theorem leftCosetEquivMapOfSurjective_smul

    (H : Subgroup P) (hker : f.ker ≤ H)

    leftCosetEquivMapOfSurjective f hf H hker (p • q) =

name: ClassFormation.leftTransversalMapOfSurjective_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftTransversalMapOfSurjective_apply
    (f : P →* Q) (hf : Function.Surjective f)

    ((leftTransversalMapOfSurjective f hf H hker T).2.leftQuotientEquiv q : Q) =

theorem eval₂_conjugatePolynomial_baseChange
    (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
    {ι : Type w} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι K L) (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
    (z : A ⊗[K] L) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
          (R := K) (A := A) (B := L)).toRingHom)
        (fun i ↦ (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
          (R := K) (S := K) (A := A) (B := L))
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.basis A b).repr z i))
        (conjugatePolynomial b σ) =
      scalarConjugation (K := K) (L := L) A σ z

name: exists_relativeIdele_coefficientSupport
statement:
theorem exists_relativeIdele_coefficientSupport
    (z : RelativeIdeleGroup K L) :
    ∃ S : Finset (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)),
      (∀ w, w ∉ S →
        (∀ i : RelativeAdeleBasisIndex (K := K) (L := L),
          (relativeAdeleCoefficient
              (K := K) (L := L)
              (z : RelativeAdeleRing K L) i).2 w ∈
            w.adicCompletionIntegers K) ∧
        (∀ i : RelativeAdeleBasisIndex (K := K) (L := L),
          (relativeAdeleCoefficient
              (K := K) (L := L)
              ((z⁻¹ : RelativeIdeleGroup K L) :
                RelativeAdeleRing K L) i).2 w ∈
            w.adicCompletionIntegers K)) ∧
      (∀ w, w ∉ S →
        RelativeBasisIntegralAt
          (K := K) (L := L) w
          ((RelativeIdeleGroup.finiteComponent
              (K := K) (L := L) w z :
              (w.adicCompletion K ⊗[K] L)ˣ) :
              w.adicCompletion K ⊗[K] L) ∧
        RelativeBasisIntegralAt
          (K := K) (L := L) w
          ((((RelativeIdeleGroup.finiteComponent
              (K := K) (L := L) w z)⁻¹ :
              (w.adicCompletion K ⊗[K] L)ˣ) :
              w.adicCompletion K ⊗[K] L)))

statement:

    (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
    {ι : Type z} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι K L) (f : L →ₐ[K] M)
    (x : A ⊗[K] L) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
          (R := K) (A := A) (B := M)).toRingHom)
        (fun i ↦
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
            (R := K) (S := K) (A := A) (B := M))
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.basis A b).repr x i))
        (embeddingPolynomial b f) =
      scalarEmbedding A f x

name: AlgebraicNumberTheory.PowerResidueSymbols.gaussReciprocity
statement:
theorem gaussReciprocity
    {a b : ℤ} (ha : Odd a) (hb : Odd b)
    (hab : a.natAbs.Coprime b.natAbs) :
    J(a | b.natAbs) * J(b | a.natAbs) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^
        (a.natAbs / 2 * (b.natAbs / 2) +
          (if a < 0 then b.natAbs / 2 else 0) +
          (if b < 0 then a.natAbs / 2 else 0))

    (K : Type u) (L : Type v)
    [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [Field L] [NumberField L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (I : NumberFieldFractionalIdealGroup L)
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    FractionalIdeal.count K w
        ((fractionalIdealNorm K L I : NumberFieldFractionalIdealGroup K) :
          FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (𝓞 K)) K) =
      (NumberFieldFractionalIdealGroup.countVector I).sum fun W n =>
        if fractionalIdealNormPrimeBelow K L W = w then
          (W.asIdeal.inertiaDeg (𝓞 K) : ℤ) * n else 0

    {n : Nat} {Vn Vsucc : Subgroup 𝒪[L]ˣ}
    (hVn : (Vn : Set 𝒪[L]ˣ) = chosenNormalBasisPrincipalUnitSet K L n)

              ((((v : 𝒪[L]ˣ) : 𝒪[L]) - 1 : 𝒪[L]) : L))) ∈

        (((((u * v : 𝒪[L]ˣ) : 𝒪[L]) - 1 : 𝒪[L]) : L) -
            (((((u : 𝒪[L]ˣ) : 𝒪[L]) - 1 : 𝒪[L]) : L) +
              ((((v : 𝒪[L]ˣ) : 𝒪[L]) - 1 : 𝒪[L]) : L))) ∈

name: ClassFieldTheory.fieldNormHom_map_ringEquiv

theorem fieldNormHom_map_ringEquiv
    (eF : F ≃+* F') (eM : M ≃+* M')
    (he : (algebraMap F' M').comp eF.toRingHom =
      eM.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap F M))

    (hgenerator : Subgroup.zpowers (β (f u)) = ⊤)
    (hexponent : ∀ z : G, z ^ orderOf (β (f u)) = 1)
    (hsubgroups : ∀ (S : Subgroup G) (x : A), f x ∈ S → g x ∈ S)
    (hquotient : ∀ x : A, β (g x) = β (f x)) :
    f = g

name: LocalClassFieldTheory.prod_embeddings_algebraMap_powerBasisGen_eq

theorem prod_embeddings_algebraMap_powerBasisGen_eq
    (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    {L E : Type} [Field L] [Field E]
    [Algebra k L] [Algebra k E] [Algebra L E] [IsScalarTower k L E]
    [FiniteDimensional k L] [Algebra.IsSeparable k L]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable k E] [FiniteDimensional k E]

    ∏ σ : E →ₐ[k] Ω, σ (algebraMap L E pb.gen) =

name: LubinTate.EqualCharacteristic.contractingFrobeniusEquationCoeff_eq
statement:
theorem contractingFrobeniusEquationCoeff_eq
    (φ : R →+* R) (γ β : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    contractingFrobeniusEquationCoeff φ γ β n =
      PowerSeries.coeff n β +
        ∑ k : Fin n,
          PowerSeries.coeff (k.1 + 1) γ *
            φ (contractingFrobeniusEquationCoeff φ γ β (n - 1 - k.1))

name: LubinTate.EqualCharacteristic.contractingFrobeniusEquationSolution_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractingFrobeniusEquationSolution_coeff
    (φ : R →+* R) (γ β : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n

name: LubinTate.EqualCharacteristic.contractingFrobeniusEquationSolution_spec

    (φ : R →+* R) (γ β : R⟦X⟧)

    contractingFrobeniusEquationSolution φ γ β =
      β + γ * PowerSeries.map φ
        (contractingFrobeniusEquationSolution φ γ β)

name: LubinTate.EqualCharacteristic.contractingFrobeniusEquationSolution_unique
statement:
theorem contractingFrobeniusEquationSolution_unique
    (φ : R →+* R) (γ β α : R⟦X⟧)
    (hγ : PowerSeries.coeff 0 γ = 0)

name: ClassFieldTheory.fractionalIdealNorm_primeExponent
statement:
theorem fractionalIdealNorm_primeExponent
    (K : Type u) (L : Type v)
    [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [Field L] [NumberField L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (I : NumberFieldFractionalIdealGroup L)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) :
    FractionalIdeal.count K v
        ((fractionalIdealNorm K L I : NumberFieldFractionalIdealGroup K) :
          FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors (𝓞 K)) K) =
      (NumberFieldFractionalIdealGroup.countVector I).sum fun W n =>
        if fractionalIdealNormPrimeBelow K L W = v then
          (W.asIdeal.inertiaDeg (𝓞 K) : ℤ) * n
        else 0

name: ClassFieldTheory.kummerAlgebra_exists_algEquiv_pi_simpleFields
statement:
theorem kummerAlgebra_exists_algEquiv_pi_simpleFields
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ+) (a : Kˣ)
    (hn : IsUnit ((n : ℕ) : K)) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I) (E : I → Type u)
      (_ : ∀ i, Field (E i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra K (E i))
      (e : KummerAlgebra K n a ≃ₐ[K] ∀ i, E i),
      ∀ i, Module.Finite K (E i) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (E i) ∧
        ∃ β : E i,
          β = (e (AdjoinRoot.root
            (Polynomial.X ^ (n : ℕ) - Polynomial.C (a : K)))) i ∧
          β ^ (n : ℕ) = algebraMap K (E i) (a : K) ∧
          IntermediateField.adjoin K {β} = ⊤

name: ClassFieldTheory.kummerAlgebra_exists_algEquiv_pi_isomorphicFields
statement:
theorem kummerAlgebra_exists_algEquiv_pi_isomorphicFields
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ+) (a : Kˣ)
    (hn : IsUnit ((n : ℕ) : K))
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I) (E : I → Type u)
      (_ : ∀ i, Field (E i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra K (E i))
      (e : KummerAlgebra K n a ≃ₐ[K] ∀ i, E i),
      (∀ i, Module.Finite K (E i) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (E i) ∧
        ∃ β : E i,
          β = (e (AdjoinRoot.root
            (Polynomial.X ^ (n : ℕ) - Polynomial.C (a : K)))) i ∧
          β ^ (n : ℕ) = algebraMap K (E i) (a : K) ∧
          IntermediateField.adjoin K {β} = ⊤) ∧
      ∀ i j, Nonempty (E i ≃ₐ[K] E j)

name: ClassFieldTheory.kummerAlgebra_exists_uniformFactorDegree
statement:
theorem kummerAlgebra_exists_uniformFactorDegree
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ+) (a : Kˣ)
    (hn : IsUnit ((n : ℕ) : K))
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I) (E : I → Type u)
      (_ : ∀ i, Field (E i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra K (E i))
      (_ : KummerAlgebra K n a ≃ₐ[K] ∀ i, E i) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d ∧
      (∀ i, Module.Finite K (E i) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (E i) ∧
        Module.finrank K (E i) = d) ∧
      (∀ i j, Nonempty (E i ≃ₐ[K] E j)) ∧
      Nat.card I * d = (n : ℕ) ∧ Nat.card I = (n : ℕ) / d

name: ClassFieldTheory.kummerAlgebra_exists_pi_copies_simpleFactor
statement:
theorem kummerAlgebra_exists_pi_copies_simpleFactor
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ+) (a : Kˣ)
    (hn : IsUnit ((n : ℕ) : K))
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty) :
    ∃ (F : Type u) (_ : Field F) (_ : Algebra K F)
      (_ : Module.Finite K F) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K F) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d ∧ Module.finrank K F = d ∧
      ((n : ℕ) / d) * d = (n : ℕ) ∧
      ∃ e : KummerAlgebra K n a ≃ₐ[K] (Fin ((n : ℕ) / d) → F),
        ∀ z : KummerAlgebra K n a,
          Algebra.norm K z = ∏ j : Fin ((n : ℕ) / d), Algebra.norm K (e z j)

      (_ : ∀ i, Field (E i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra K (E i))
      (e : KummerAlgebra K n a ≃ₐ[K] ∀ i, E i),
      (∀ i, Module.Finite K (E i) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (E i)) ∧
      ∀ z : KummerAlgebra K n a,
        Algebra.norm K z = ∏ i, Algebra.norm K (e z i)

name: ClassFieldTheory.mem_fieldNormSubgroup_iff_ringEquiv

theorem mem_fieldNormSubgroup_iff_ringEquiv

name: CyclicCohomology.ProfiniteCohomology.Herbrand.herbrand_exact_cardinality_identity
statement:
theorem herbrand_exact_cardinality_identity
    [Group G] [Fintype G]
    [CommGroup A] [CommGroup B] [CommGroup C]
    [MulDistribMulAction G A] [MulDistribMulAction G B]
    [MulDistribMulAction G C]
    (i : A →* B) (j : B →* C)
    (hi : ∀ (g : G) (a : A), i (g • a) = g • i a)
    (hj : ∀ (g : G) (b : B), j (g • b) = g • j b)
    (hker : ∀ b : B, j b = 1 ↔ ∃ a : A, i a = b)
    (hinj : Function.Injective i)
    (hsurj : ∀ c : C, ∃ b : B, j b = c)
    (σ : G) (hgen : ∀ g : G, g ∈ Subgroup.zpowers σ)
    [Finite (HerbrandH0 G A)] [Finite (HerbrandHMinusOne G A σ)]
    [Finite (HerbrandH0 G B)] [Finite (HerbrandHMinusOne G B σ)]
    [Finite (HerbrandH0 G C)] [Finite (HerbrandHMinusOne G C σ)] :
    Nat.card (HerbrandH0 G B) *
        Nat.card (HerbrandHMinusOne G A σ) *
        Nat.card (HerbrandHMinusOne G C σ) =
      Nat.card (HerbrandH0 G A) *
        Nat.card (HerbrandH0 G C) *
        Nat.card (HerbrandHMinusOne G B σ)

name: CyclicCohomology.ProfiniteCohomology.Herbrand.herbrandQuotient_exact_multiplicative
statement:
theorem herbrandQuotient_exact_multiplicative
    {G A B C : Type}
    [Group G] [Fintype G]
    [CommGroup A] [CommGroup B] [CommGroup C]
    [MulDistribMulAction G A] [MulDistribMulAction G B]
    [MulDistribMulAction G C]
    (i : A →* B) (j : B →* C)
    (hi : ∀ (g : G) (a : A), i (g • a) = g • i a)
    (hj : ∀ (g : G) (b : B), j (g • b) = g • j b)
    (hker : ∀ b : B, j b = 1 ↔ ∃ a : A, i a = b)
    (hinj : Function.Injective i)
    (hsurj : ∀ c : C, ∃ b : B, j b = c) (σ : G)
    (hgen : ∀ g : G, g ∈ Subgroup.zpowers σ)
    [Finite (HerbrandH0 G A)] [Finite (HerbrandHMinusOne G A σ)]
    [Finite (HerbrandH0 G B)] [Finite (HerbrandHMinusOne G B σ)]
    [Finite (HerbrandH0 G C)] [Finite (HerbrandHMinusOne G C σ)] :

name: CyclicCohomology.averagedLatticeVector_apply

theorem averagedLatticeVector_apply

name: CyclicCohomology.exists_complete_permutationSublattice
statement:
theorem exists_complete_permutationSublattice
    (ρ : G →* Equiv.Perm ι)
    (L : Submodule ℤ (ι → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L]
    [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (hL : ∀ (g : G) (x : ι → ℝ), x ∈ L →
      permutationRepresentation ρ g x ∈ L) :
    ∃ L' : Submodule ℤ (ι → ℝ),
      L' ≤ L ∧
      DiscreteTopology L' ∧
      Submodule.span ℝ (L' : Set (ι → ℝ)) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ b : Basis ι ℤ L',
        ∀ (g : G) (i : ι),
          permutationRepresentation ρ g
              (b i : ι → ℝ) =
            (b (ρ g i) : ι → ℝ)

    (L : Submodule ℤ E) [DiscreteTopology L]
    [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (hL : ∀ (g : G) (x : E), x ∈ L →
      α g x ∈ L) :
    ∃ L' : Submodule ℤ E,
      L' ≤ L ∧
      DiscreteTopology L' ∧
      Submodule.span ℝ (L' : Set E) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ b' : Basis ι ℤ L',

name: RamificationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration.gradedPieceLift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedPieceLift_mk {H : Type v} [Group H] (n : ℕ)
    (f : F.lower n →* H)
    (h : (F.lower (n + 1)).subgroupOf (F.lower n) ≤ f.ker)
    (σ : F.lower n) :
    F.gradedPieceLift n f h (F.gradedPieceMk n σ) = f σ

name: RamificationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration.gradedPieceMap_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedPieceMap_apply_mk {H : Type v} [Group H]
    (E : AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration H) (n m : ℕ)
    (f : F.lower n →* E.lower m)
    (h : ∀ σ : F.lower n, (σ : G) ∈ F.lower (n + 1) →
      ((f σ : E.lower m) : H) ∈ E.lower (m + 1))
    (σ : F.lower n) :
    F.gradedPieceMap E n m f h (F.gradedPieceMk n σ) =
      E.gradedPieceMk m (f σ)

name: RamificationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration.gradedPieceMk_apply

name: RamificationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration.gradedPieceMk_eq_iff

theorem gradedPieceMk_eq_iff (n : ℕ) (σ τ : F.lower n) :
    F.gradedPieceMk n σ = F.gradedPieceMk n τ ↔

name: RamificationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration.gradedPieceMk_eq_one_iff
statement:

theorem gradedPieceMk_eq_one_iff (n : ℕ) (σ : F.lower n) :

name: RamificationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration.quotientLift_mk

name: RamificationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration.quotientMap_apply_mk

name: RamificationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration.subquotientMap_apply_mk
statement:

theorem subquotientMap_apply_mk {H : Type v} [Group H]

name: RamificationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.AntitoneNormalSubgroupFiltration.tameQuotientMk_eq_one_iff

theorem baseChange_pi_finrank_eq_sum

    {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (B : I → Type*) [∀ i, Field (B i)] [∀ i, Algebra A (B i)]
    [∀ i, Module.Finite A (B i)]

      ∑ i, Algebra.trace A (B i) (e (1 ⊗ₜ[K] x) i)
